title: Prospective Executable-Support Selection Geometry, Source-Failure-Aware Cohort Reconstitution, Conditional Activation-Transport Identification, Source-Disjoint Calibration Replication & Authority-Gated Contrastive Explanation Experiment
main_question: Can an auditable source-identity and executable-support selection process distinguish source-accrual failure, structural intervention ineligibility, and conditional activation transport, then yield prospective source-disjoint calibration evidence without turning selection into an outcome-conditioned search?

novelty_boundary.not_new: generic dataset shift, positivity, outcome-blind sampling, logistic calibration or causal transportability
novelty_boundary.candidate_contribution: typed executable-support selection as a measurable pre-outcome experimental object whose attrition and transport target are recorded independently of the mediator activation endpoint, with a causal-authority firewall in the PGN implementation
novelty_boundary.not_P24_repeat: P24 never acquired a complete six-source cohort or opened outcomes. P25 treats source identity and support-selection geometry as distinct research objects before testing a frozen transport model.
novelty_boundary.track_A: scientific near-equal engine move preference and mechanism activation
novelty_boundary.track_B: GitHub compiler + PGN explanation authority routing with no Track B-to-A promotion

estimands.source_realisability: I_s=1 iff event/section identity, completed status, section-scope PGN and exact raw-byte SHA are independently evidenced
estimands.executable_support: R(e,x,f)=1 iff pair qualifies and all frozen routed TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM BASE arms are legal and repeatably measurable
estimands.selection_yield: P(R=1|I_s=1,source ecology,engine,family) measured before activation outcomes; descriptive and selection-design-only
estimands.primary_activation: P(A_f=1|R=1,z) on a source-disjoint target population; not all chess worlds
estimands.activation: A_f=1 iff FULL_CLASS support differs from BASE under frozen grammar

transfer: IM VII Round Robin, Chess Club Radnicki Kovin

frozen_conditions: Exact section-tournament parent locator, scope and finished status verified
Raw PGN bytes, SHA-256 and Drive custody captured
Calibration vs transfer exact-world duplicate removal under predeclared deterministic rule
Source role and accrual order frozen before inspecting any R yield or A outcome
phase_A_source_identity.replacement_rule: Only identity/completeness/bytes failure before source-support inspection. A replacement needs another human-reviewed pre-outcome amendment; no yield-based substitution.

must_record: source candidates and exact failure reasons
stable BASE measurement counts per engine/source/family
support conditioning distribution shifts in pre-outcome context features
phase_B_selection_geometry.firewall: Do not use activation labels or any predicted ACTIVE rate in selection or quota stopping.
phase_B_selection_geometry.interpretation: Conditioned sample pertains only to executable-support-qualified target worlds; selection-on-R is not population representativeness.
phase_B_selection_geometry.stop: If either cohort misses support quota, HOLD; never lower quotas or source-swap based on yield.

phase_C_activation_transport.selection: Calibration cohort leave-one-source-out log loss; choose lowest-complexity candidate within 0.01 of best; within candidate minimum log loss penalty, tie larger penalty; threshold max held-out BA, tie higher threshold; seal model coefficients/comparator/hash before transfer.

authority.q0: DENIED until prospective transport PASS with supported predicted ACTIVE cells, then separate Q0 local evidence gate
authority.track_B: ABSTAIN_ECOLOGY_CALIBRATION_UNVERIFIED until positive scientific receipt; no certificate without independent evidence
authority.github: No github-actions[bot] author or committer; Actions artifact-only, contents:read

publication.claim_ceiling: P24 closure is administrative HOLD, not an empirical transport failure; report it as a source-identification constraint, not positive or negative activation evidence
publication.figures: evidence ladder, source→pair→chain selection flow, sealed cohort/calibration transfer, abstention router
publication.results_rule: Never write P25 results until exact artifacts establish them
